text:
and neurofedback, it's the idea that first we taught them how their brain works (which had been prooved to help them better learn (because they better understand how and why they need to do it)) they are "meta-conscious" of their learning, that we call "growth mindness" THEN they do "mindfulness meditation of the brain" 

Normaly mindfulness meditation is be feel/being conscious of their body, sense ... here we propose a version "being conscious of their brain activity"

text:
but we can't have a real neurofeedback (not because it's impossible) but because it would be too expensive for a school (one device per student), so the idea is to give behavioral feedback on their meditation and state of focus : by either recording the sound of the classroom or shooting them (and analysing movement of student, we may not search for "no movement" of them but may be "synchronise small movement" "harmonious movement") [both are doable with a simple phone !] and we give feedback on that (sound/movement/state) with two output : 
- visual :  a representation of their neural activity, with two image, one representing the state to reach (some moving shape that looks like making and unmaking slowly connection between them) and a second image which would be some moving shape created according to the sound/movement of the class room (slowly transforming towards the "connecting state" but at the begining not being it)
- sound : as the meditation Ohms, we create sound from the sound/movement of the class base on a frequency, that change toward the good meditation frequency (so should push them towards the good state)
